//: The compatibility fixture index: which fixtures the matrix loads and what each one is for. Layer values are Kimi's four layers (1 skills, 2 hooks, 3 mcp, 4 plugins) from plan-plugin-contract.md section 1.1.4; pi has the first three natively, which is why the fixtures spread across all four.

fixtures.name: exhaustive-switch
fixtures.note: R8 pin, positive case: an exhaustive switch over the event union with no default branch. Must stop compiling when an event is added. Its sibling is the control.

fixtures.name: exhaustive-switch-with-default
fixtures.note: R8 pin, control case: the same switch with a default branch. Must keep compiling when an event is added, so the pin does not obstruct additive evolution.

fixtures.name: tool-register
fixtures.note: registerTool with a typebox schema: covers tool.register and the typebox allowlist entry

fixtures.name: events-only
fixtures.note: subscribes to four events and returns a result for two of them: covers event.subscribe

fixtures.name: provider-oauth
fixtures.note: registerProvider with an oauth block, including the deprecated usesCallbackServer

fixtures.name: mcp-server
fixtures.note: registerMcpServer with an http transport: covers the mcp.register capability

fixtures.name: manifest-unknown-fields
fixtures.note: a manifest with unknown keys: unknown fields must be ignored silently, never warned about

fixtures.name: min-host-version
fixtures.note: minHostVersion this host does not satisfy: must warn and still load

fixtures.name: legacy-no-manifest
fixtures.note: no pi block at all: the legacy tier, which must load without a warning on every host
